title: Claude Dashboard
description: See every Claude Code session from all your VS Code windows in one place – working, waiting for you or done – and jump into the right window with one click. Local only. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.

title: TokenSpend AI — AI coding spend by project and commit
description: See what your AI coding costs, by project, task and commit. Reads the usage logs of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code and Continue on your computer. No account, no telemetry.

title: Deterministic Data Quality & Integrity Assessor
description: Scans CSV and JSON datasets locally in VS Code for floating-point errors, NULL anomalies, and rounding discrepancies with zero server data retention.

title: Inkstand
description: A beautiful rendered view for Markdown in VS Code: source view, table of contents, reading position and side-by-side editing.

title: Repo Board
description: All your git repos on one board: auto-discovers every repo on disk, shows which ones are dirty, behind or ahead at a glance, and switches between them with Ctrl+Alt+P. Fetch or pull them all in one click.

title: Spotify Now Playing
description: Shows the current Spotify track in the status bar. Click it to open Spotify.
